reasons: Deviation classification is correct: the only TrueLink warranty (Section 9) is a Y2K date-processing warranty, and Section 11's 'same degree of care ... customarily exercised by it for its own operations' is a self-referential standard with no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair/re-performance/refund remedy, so the clause set fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).

Redline is actionable and reaches the playbook preferred position with a targeted insert into Section 9: workmanlike services warranty, conformance warranty (12 months software / 90 days services), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and a repair/re-perform/refund remedy at Vendor's option; no unnecessary rewriting of surrounding text.

The analysis correctly identifies that the p0076 disclaimer is prefaced 'EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT' and therefore does not swallow the express warranty, so no carve-out edit was needed — no over-editing.
Comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, cites the playbook position and offers the 90-day/30-day fallback; deterministic checks pass.

Minor (rationale-level, not disqualifying): the 12-month software conformance period runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery/acceptance, which is slightly less favorable to us than the model language and could be re-anchored to delivery.
